extraction_hints.recording_button_index: In the full-year class-records view, the 'View Recording' buttons are in chronological DOM order; L01 = button index 16 (0-based), so index = 15 + lesson number. UI-coupled: always re-verify by matching the Vimeo ID in the player frame URL.
extraction_hints.transcript_extraction: Open the recording modal -> find the Vimeo iframe -> parse the inline 'window.playerConfig' script -> request.text_tracks[0].url (signed, ~24h expiry) -> fetch the VTT from the MAIN LMS page context (in-frame fetch is blocked by the player's CSP connect-src) -> save raw.
extraction_hints.modal_close: Close via '.modal-content button.close' before opening the next class.
extraction_hints.ai_summaries: LMS AI summaries (summary_signed_url) exist only for classes from ~Jul 2026 onward; none for Batch 01.
